---
title: "Day 22 | New Tool"
format: html
---

Source: Kraftfahrtbundesamt (KBA)
https://www.kba.de/DE/Statistik/Produktkatalog/produkte/Fahrzeuge/fz28/fz28_gentab.html?nn=864666


```{ggsql}
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT
    month_date,
    100 * share_bev AS share_bev
  FROM '../19/df_registrations_combined.csv'
),
tesla AS (
  SELECT
    month_date,
    100 * share_tesla::DOUBLE AS share_tesla
  FROM '../19/df_registrations_combined.csv' 
  WHERE year >= 2021
),
raw_with_prev AS (
  SELECT
    month_date,
    share_bev,
    LAG(share_bev) OVER (ORDER BY month_date) AS prev_bev
  FROM raw
),
steps AS (
  SELECT month_date - 15 AS x, share_bev AS y, 1 AS ord FROM raw
  UNION ALL
  SELECT month_date - 15 AS x, prev_bev AS y, 0 AS ord
  FROM raw_with_prev
  WHERE prev_bev IS NOT NULL
),
annotations(date, y, label) AS (VALUES
  (DATE '2019-07-01', 10,  'June 2020:\nPurchase\nincentive\nintroduced'),
  (DATE '2020-10-01', 25, 'Fall 2021: Rush before\nscheduled 2021 expiry\nand government change.'),
  (DATE '2022-09-01', 35.5,  'Dec 2022: Last chance for maximum incentive\nbefore rates decreased in Jan 2023.'),
  (DATE '2023-10-01', 31.5,  'Aug 2023: Final month for\nincentive for commercial buyers.'),
  (DATE '2023-12-01', 26,  'Dec 2023: Immediate termination\nof all EV subsidies following\nfederal budget ruling.'),
  (DATE '2024-01-01', 6.25,  'Black bars: Share of newly\nregistered Tesla cars\n(starting from Jan 2021)')
)

SELECT x, y, ord FROM steps

VISUALISE x AS x, y AS y
-- lightgrey fill
DRAW segment
  MAPPING month_date AS x, month_date AS xend, 0 AS y, share_bev AS yend FROM raw
  SETTING col => '#8eeffacc', linewidth => 4.5
-- paths
DRAW path
  SETTING color => '#08abbd', linewidth => 1
  ORDER BY x, ord
-- Tesla contribution
DRAW segment
  MAPPING month_date AS x, month_date AS xend, 0 AS y, share_tesla AS yend FROM tesla
  SETTING color => '#333333', linewidth => 3
-- Annotations
DRAW text
  MAPPING date AS x, y, label FROM annotations
  SETTING 
    fontsize => 7, 
    typeface => 'Instrument Sans',
    hjust => 'left',
    vjust => 'bottom'
SCALE CONTINUOUS x 
  VIA date 
  RENAMING * => '{:time %Y}'
SCALE CONTINUOUS y
  RENAMING * => '{}%'
LABEL
  title => 'BEV sales driven by government subsidy deadlines and customer anticipations',
  subtitle => 'Monthly share of battery electric vehicles (BEV) among new car registrations in Germany (in %)',
  caption => 'Source: Kraftfahrtbundesamt (March 2026). Visualization: Ansgar Wolsing',
  x => NULL, 
  y => NULL
```
